`Dehydration lines are temporary, shallow, cross-hatched surface creases caused by a lack of moisture in the skin, whereas wrinkles are deeper, permanent structural creases caused by the long-term breakdown of collagen and elastin`.[[1]](https://www.theinkeylist.com/blogs/news/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)[[2]](https://uk.theinkeylist.com/blogs/news/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)

### Key Differences

- **Cause** 
	- **Dehydration Lines:** A water deficiency at the skin's surface, a compromised skin barrier, harsh weather, or lack of topical moisture.
	- **Wrinkles:** Natural aging, cumulative UV exposure, genetics, and repetitive muscle movements (such as smiling or squinting).[[1]](https://uk.theinkeylist.com/blogs/news/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)[[2]](https://www.theinkeylist.com/blogs/news/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)[[3]](https://www.clinikally.com/blogs/news/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)
- **Appearance** 
	- **Dehydration Lines:** Fine, shallow, crepey, and spread out in a network or "cross-hatch" pattern. They often make the skin look like crumpled tissue paper.
	- **Wrinkles:** Deeper, more defined, and set into the skin. They follow the underlying facial muscle patterns (such as crow’s feet or forehead furrows).[[1]](https://dermaflash.com/blogs/blog/do-you-have-fake-wrinkles-aka-dehydration-lines)[[2]](https://www.theinkeylist.com/blogs/news/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)[[3]](https://www.penndermspecialists.com/understanding-skin-aging-wrinkles/)
- **Behavior & Permanence** 
	- **Dehydration Lines:** Temporary and fully reversible. They soften or vanish when you restore skin hydration, and they may temporarily worsen right after cleansing.
	- **Wrinkles:** Permanent and structural. They remain visible even when the skin is deeply moisturized, though their appearance can be softened with anti-aging ingredients.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DU9Idn9DY6o/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.theinkeylist.com/blogs/news/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)[[3]](https://us.yonka.com/es/blogs/anti-ageing-tips/does-dehydration-cause-wrinkles-on-face)
- **How to Test Them** 
	- **Pinch Test:** Gently pinch the skin or press moisture into it. Dehydration lines fade or bounce back quickly with humectants and moisturizers, while true wrinkles stay put.[[1]](https://clderm.com/do-i-have-fine-lines-or-wrinkles/)[[2]](https://dermaflash.com/blogs/blog/do-you-have-fake-wrinkles-aka-dehydration-lines)[[3]](https://www.theinkeylist.com/blogs/news/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)

### How to Treat Each One

- **For Dehydration Lines:** 
	- Focus on hydrating humectants like **hyaluronic acid**, **glycerin** , or **ectoin** applied to damp skin.
	- Seal the hydration in with barrier-repairing emollients or ceramides.
	- Avoid over-cleansing, harsh stripping soaps, and over-exfoliation.[[1]](https://skintypesolutions.com/blogs/skincare/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)[[2]](https://uk.theinkeylist.com/blogs/news/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)[[3]](https://dermaflash.com/blogs/blog/do-you-have-fake-wrinkles-aka-dehydration-lines)
- **For Wrinkles:** 
	- Incorporate long-term structural ingredients like **retinoids (retinol)**, **peptides**, **vitamin C** , and daily **broad-spectrum SPF 50** sunscreen.[[1]](https://www.charlottetilbury.com/us/secrets/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)[[2]](https://skintypesolutions.com/blogs/skincare/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)

Learn more about identifying and treating them via [The INKEY List](https://www.theinkeylist.com/blogs/news/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles) or [Dermaflash](https://dermaflash.com/blogs/blog/do-you-have-fake-wrinkles-aka-dehydration-lines).[[1]](https://www.theinkeylist.com/blogs/news/dehydration-lines-vs-wrinkles)[[2]](https://dermaflash.com/blogs/blog/do-you-have-fake-wrinkles-aka-dehydration-lines)If you'd like, share **where the lines are located** (forehead, under-eyes, etc.) and **how quickly they appeared** , and I can help you figure out which one you might be dealing with.
